_comment: Signal rules for the nightly zone scan (tools/signal-scan.js).
Change a value, commit, push - tonight's 18:00 IST run picks it up. No code edits needed.
Missing keys fall back to the built-in defaults noted below.
Unknown keys or wrong-typed values ABORT the run (fail-closed), so a typo can never
silently disable a filter you believed was on.
Keys:
trendFilter  bool    default false - signal only when the EMA10/20/50 stack agrees
(LONG needs UPTREND, SHORT needs DOWNTREND). With true, a full
57x3 scan drops from ~100 signals to roughly 3-5 focused ones.
insideOnly   bool    default false - signal only when the bar CLOSED inside the zone
instead of merely touching it (touch = low<=top and high>=bottom).
Stricter: fewer, higher-conviction touches.
minVolume    number  default 0 - minimum volume on the SIGNAL BAR (the latest bar).
0 disables. Warning: Yahoo EOD volume is unreliable for many
NSE symbols (often 0 or stale), so treat this as a coarse
dead-market filter, not a liquidity ranking. Commodities
futures (GC=F etc.) report contract volume and work well.
stopBufPct   number  default 0.5 - stop sits this % beyond the zone edge.
rrTarget     number  default 2.0 - target = entry +/- risk * rrTarget.
pivotLeft    int     default 3 - pivot strength to the left (zone sensitivity).
pivotRight   int     default 3 - pivot strength to the right (zone confirmation lag).
minConfluence int    default 0 - MEASURED rulebook-tier gate (scanner-logic.js).
Score 0-6 per signal, built only from conditions that beat their
own absence in tools/research-thin-commodities.js: +2 above the
rising 200-SMA, +2 fresh CHoCH, +1 EMA crossback, +1 Base n'
Break. 0 disables. Tags: 5+ A+, 3-4 A, 2 B, 0-1 C.
NOTE: the browser scanner (scanner.html) has its own checkboxes for trend and touch
rules and does not read this file - this governs the nightly GitHub Actions scan only.
